title: Horticultural Statistics at a Glance 2018
publisher: National Horticulture Board, Government of India
estimateStatus: The state tables do not specify whether each annual value is final or advance.
licenseAndReuse: The report footer states copyright National Horticulture Board. No separate open-data license or reuse terms were located. This repository includes a small attributed factual extract; confirm source terms before broader redistribution or commercial use.
cleaning: Trim whitespace and parse numeric fields with comma separators supported.
Treat blank cells, hyphens, em dashes, and common null markers as missing; do not fill them.
Map source crop labels to stable Meraki IDs: Chillies (Green) to green-chilli, Okra to okra, Tomato to tomato.
Convert thousand hectares to hectares and acres; convert thousand metric tonnes to tonnes and kilograms.
Derive annual yield only when both area and production are present and area is greater than zero.
Preserve crop year and source table/page; season remains null because these tables do not provide a season split.
limitations: The source values are state-level official statistics; the table does not disclose its estimate status.
This publication is old and only contains three consecutive crop years for this extract.
No district, season, variety, farm, irrigation, soil, weather, grade, loss, or buyer-demand observations are included.
Missing source observations remain null and are excluded from the baseline sample.
dataProvider: Horticulture Statistics Division, Department of Agriculture, Cooperation and Farmers Welfare, Government of India (as credited in the source tables)

agronomicReference.title: FAO ECOCROP crop data sheets
agronomicReference.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
agronomicReference.geographicCoverage: Global species-level ecological envelopes; not Maharashtra-specific.
agronomicReference.licenseAndReuse: FAO website terms state that content may be copied for private study, research, teaching, and non-commercial products or services with appropriate acknowledgement. Commercial use, adaptation, or resale requires permission. No ECOCROP-specific open-data license was identified; review FAO terms before broader or commercial reuse.
limitations: FAO reports that the original ECOCROP database was discontinued around 2015 and is now accessible through the GAEZ platform.
Optimal and absolute ecological ranges are global species-level descriptors, not Maharashtra-specific recommendations or cultivar guarantees.
Annual rainfall is not irrigation demand; the source does not provide crop irrigation requirements in these sheets.
These values are screening references only and do not estimate yield, profitability, or economic suitability.
